channel.title: Mohit Singh Rajput — Notes from the Loss Curve
channel.description: Essays on AI/ML engineering — LLM agents, RAG, computer vision, deployment and honest data science.

item.title: What Building a Multi-Agent Support System Taught Me About LLM Orchestration
item.description: Supervisor agents sound elegant on whiteboards. In practice, routing, state and failure recovery are where the real engineering lives.

item.title: RAG Is a Retrieval Problem Before It Is a Generation Problem
item.description: Most bad RAG answers are bad retrieval. Chunking strategy, embedding choice and evaluation loops matter more than the model behind the prompt.

item.title: Reading Emotions: CNNs for Faces vs. Features for Speech
item.description: I built emotion recognition twice — once from pixels, once from audio. Comparing the two pipelines reveals a lot about representation learning.
